title: Containment door window caption
description: Structured caption for one 5-second window (10 frames) from one camera. All states refer to the END of the window unless the field name says otherwise.

door_state.description: closed: fully shut. passing: open while a person (or a cart pushed by a person) is moving through the doorway. propped: held open by an object, nobody moving through. ajar: open or partly open, not held by an object, nobody moving through.

state_changed_in_window.description: True if door_state at the start of the window differs from door_state at the end.

people_visible.description: People visible in the final frame.

person_in_doorway_at_end.description: True if, in the final frames, a person is in or moving through the doorway.

object_in_doorway.description: Object in the doorway or door track at the end of the window.

caption.description: One factual sentence describing the window.
